PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.89, hemoglobin 12.8, platelets 214, sodium 139, wbc 9.3; vitals dbp 72-77, heart_rate 73-78, map 92-97, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 15-17, sbp 132-138, spo2 97-98, temp 36.6-36.9

Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Hypertension. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 65-year-old female, length of stay 2 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Hypertension. Follow up with primary care in one week.
